title: IPORA — IP management platform
role: Sole architect & builder, then Project Manager
problem: Trademark, patent, copyright and industrial-design portfolios were run from spreadsheets and inboxes.
did: Designed and built the platform end to end (Nuxt 3 + TypeScript front end, Django + PostgreSQL back end), bilingual Arabic/English with genuine RTL, role-scoped operations tooling, bilingual PDF portfolio reports for clients; replaced a rejected Power BI build with a custom reporting module; founded the QA practice (530+ Selenium test cases across 170+ features, manual regression down 40%) and wrote 59-page developer docs that halved onboarding; led a cloud migration with zero downtime.
outcome: 52 services in production; the daily system of record for operations.

title: TM Watch — trademark monitoring & opposition tracking
problem: Deciding which of thousands of newly published marks per day actually threaten a client's portfolio, across countries and two scripts, and defending that judgement to a lawyer.
did: Ran a four-vendor RFQ, then designed and led the in-house build: a staged funnel — Nice-class filter → vector nearest-neighbour retrieval → composite phonetic/visual/semantic ranking → LLM verdict — judged against historical cases before anyone relied on it.
outcome: In production; monitors registries and gazettes across 21 countries with notifications in 12 languages, handling 8,000–20,000 new marks a day.

title: Cepro.ai — brand-protection platform site
role: Owner of the rebuild, scoping to launch
problem: Legacy site could not carry a bilingual, AI-led product story.
did: Rebuilt on Next.js 15 + React 19 — 17 pages, in-browser Arabic OCR with Tesseract.js, full Arabic/English.

title: Cepro Dashboard — brand-protection operations
problem: Incidents across web, social media, app stores and dark-web sources were tracked by hand with no SLA visibility.
did: Built the operations platform — incident intake and evidence, SLA-tracked takedown workflow, role-based access.

title: Digitee — six production apps as sole frontend engineer
did: Mintora print-on-demand platform; AR virtual try-on (TensorFlow.js + MediaPipe Pose); Three.js 3D showroom; five-country e-commerce with geo-aware routing, PayPal + Kashier, five languages; B2B dashboard with AI image generation and 16-language i18n with full RTL.

title: Keme — US clinic-management platform
did: Built front-end modules for patients, appointments, telehealth and billing in Vue 3 against a Laravel API.

title: Freelance — four client projects, requirements to deployment
did: Climate Risk Assessment Tool (PhD research, Leaflet maps, PDF export); Lusion 3D (Three.js WebGL); fitness e-commerce (Django REST); User Management Dashboard (TypeScript, Cypress E2E, EN/AR RTL).
